description: This file defines an internal interface IInternalGrainFactory for the Orleans framework, providing methods for creating object references, retrieving system targets, and casting grains to specific interfaces.

classes.name: IInternalGrainFactory
classes.description: An internal interface extending IGrainFactory, providing methods for internal grain management such as creating object references, obtaining system targets, and casting grains.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates a reference to the provided object implementing IAddressable.

methods.name: GetSystemTarget
methods.description: Retrieves a system target reference based on grain type and destination or grain ID.

methods.name: Cast
methods.description: Casts a grain reference to a specified interface or type.
